scope: All 200 question IDs: actual full pilot plus explicitly exposed targeted corrections. This composite is NOT a fresh 200/200 run on the final prompt. Source faithfulness is not independent historical correctness. Basic adequacy permits disclosed introductory simplifications; no perfection claim.

paired_language_appropriateness.scope: Meaning/classification appropriate to each prompt; examples may differ and conceptual prompts are not all literal translations.

social_personality.scope: Two greetings/two thanks; earlier variation and consent scenarios are separately dated.

original_quality_corrections: Restoration is within conservation, not two mutually exclusive categories.
Pottery umbrella is not universally porous.
Deeper archaeological layers are not always older.
First-hand interviews may be recorded later.
Shadow puppetry action is continuous, not frame-by-frame.
Evidence quality matters; adaptation may invent/change historical details.
remaining_limits: One conservative Chinese archaeology refusal occurred in the 28-case diagnostic; later actual English/Chinese diagnostic and real Chinese browser passed. Stochastic false refusals remain possible.
General explanations are not independently verified or a scholarly gold corpus; beginner wording leaves exceptions.
42 profiles across 14 cities are a launch baseline, not exhaustive Liaoning content.
No physical-device/screen-reader or independent specialist certification.
